items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Raps and Slane, they call me

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. So give me a D string. He said, I have a D string. I'm like, I put D. I use G. I put G. I use G. So, he said, I have G. I eat. I eat. Uh-huh. That's all I want, you know. And I thought I'd go to dance. Well, like, on a Monday, it was a Blue Monday. Well, Raps and Slane, they call me, she stayed in the shallots. And then, boom, on the ground, then, there, beer, and all that stuff, chick, get cooked. So, I turned around, I took the toolbox. Twine on it, nothing about twine. But I had a base key on it,…
I said, oh, where do you want, brother?
